home.title: Where should we deliver?
home.description: Enter your neighbourhood and a street or landmark in Douala. You can type any neighbourhood, even if it is not in the suggestions.
home.metaDescription: Enter your neighbourhood and a landmark in Douala to continue.
home.addressHint: The city is fixed to Douala. Enter your neighbourhood, then a street or landmark.
home.suggestionsUnavailable: Suggestions are temporarily unavailable. You can still type your neighbourhood.
home.deliveryFeePending: Delivery fee confirmed when you order
home.privacyNote: Your location is requested only with your permission. You can also enter a landmark.
home.addressRequired: Enter your neighbourhood and a street or landmark to continue.
home.storageError: This draft could not be saved on this device. Try again or keep your landmark handy.
home.locationUnavailable: Location is unavailable on this device. You can enter your neighbourhood.
home.locationDenied: Location access was denied. Enter your neighbourhood to continue.
home.locationTimedOut: Finding your location took too long. Enter your neighbourhood or try again.
home.locationOutsideCoverage: This location is outside the indicative boundary. You can continue by entering your neighbourhood and a landmark.
home.coordinatesReceived: Location accepted for delivery in Douala: {latitude}, {longitude}. Enter your neighbourhood and a landmark too.
home.footer: Neighbourhoods can be entered freely. The delivery fee is confirmed from the zone, if configured.
